label: Visualization
title: Visualization
subtitle: Lets agents create and display charts, diagrams, interactive data visualisations, and other HTML/JavaScript output directly inside the chat. Results are rendered live in an embedded canvas.
whenToUse: Use when an agent needs to present data visually — a chart of results, a diagram of a system, a comparison table, or any output that is clearer as a visual than as text.

methods.name: Display Visualization
methods.description: Renders an HTML page, image (PNG/SVG), or URL inside an inline canvas in the chat.

methods.name: Create Visualization
methods.description: Generates a visualisation by writing and executing HTML/JavaScript code inline. Supports Chart.js, D3, and other CDN libraries.

mediaCaption: An inline visualisation canvas in the chat showing an interactive bar chart generated from analysis results
tips: Agents can use any charting library available via CDN.
Visualisations persist in the conversation and are re-rendered when you reload the project.
